data.name: Kumaran
data.long_meaning: Kumaran is a name that holds significant importance in Hindu mythology. It is the name of the younger brother of Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Subramaniam. Kumaran is revered for his bravery and wisdom, making it an ideal name for a baby boy. In Hindu tradition, he is often depicted carrying a spear and vel, symbolizing strength and power.
